# TeilFair

> TeilFair is a free web app for splitting shared expenses fairly with friends, flatmates, and travel groups. It tracks who paid what, calculates balances, and suggests settlements. No sign-up is required.

Groups are opened through private capability links (`/g/...`). These links contain access tokens, so they are private and must never be crawled, indexed, or used for training. Only the public pages listed below may be read.

## Pages

- [TeilFair home](https://teilfair.moritzreis.dev/): Create a new group or reopen a recent group.

## Policies

- [robots.txt](https://teilfair.moritzreis.dev/robots.txt): Crawling rules. Group pages under `/g/` are excluded.
- [Agent resource manifest](https://teilfair.moritzreis.dev/.well-known/ard.json): Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) entries for this site.

## Optional

- [Source code and license](https://github.com/clFaster/TeilFair): Project repository.
